references.text: The parable of the talents sets the scene for verse 19, where the Lord returns to settle accounts with his servants.
The parable of the minas in Luke has parallels to the parable of the talents in Matthew, including the idea of a master returning after a long time to settle accounts.
Hebrews speaks of Christ coming again, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him, which can be seen as a parallel to the Lord's return in Matt 25:19.
